provenance: Deliberately constructed for Phase 30's verification of the round-cap/INCONCLUSIVE handling - the one novel behavior that phase's task explicitly said not to skip testing. An exception_handling claim with no proposed_test deterministically hits adjudicate.verifier.strategies.verify_exception_handling's honest INCONCLUSIVE fallback (already covered by Phase 28's own unit tests) - used here to drive a real rebuttal loop to its round cap and a real Judge call against a genuinely unresolved claim, neither of which had been exercised live before this phase.

claim.assertion: The except OSError: pass clause silently swallows the exception with no logging and no proposed regression test exists to mechanically confirm or refute whether this masks a real problem.
